role.label: Role
role.good: Says who the AI should be: a job, an expertise, a point of view.
role.example: You are an account manager at a web agency.

task.label: Task
task.good: Says exactly what to produce, with an action verb.
task.example: Write an email to the client about the delay.

context.label: Context
context.good: Gives the facts the AI cannot know: who, what, why, when.
context.example: The client is Martin's Bakery. The photos arrived late, so the launch moves to next Friday.

format.label: Format
format.good: Describes the result: length, tone, structure and where it will be used.

example.label: Example
example.good: Shows a sample of what good looks like, so the AI can follow the pattern.
example.example: For example: Quick update on your website...

constraint.label: Constraint
constraint.good: Sets a rule to respect: something to avoid or a limit not to cross.
constraint.example: Don't blame the client. No more than 120 words.
